claims.claim: The bike is just 3 month old and in good conditions.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a used scooter/motorbike with dirt/scuffing; no readable make/model, mileage, or proof of age.
No purchase receipt, registration date, or readable plate details in the report.
No test ride, brake test, or visible brake wear/condition details provided.
Report mentions dirt/scuffing but does not confirm rust presence/absence; surfaces are not described in enough detail.
No close-ups of components/serials or evidence of originality in the report.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or may have issues (compression, fuel delivery, overheating). Photos cannot confirm running condition.
risks.proof: Short video clip: cold start + 2–3 minutes idling + gentle acceleration; include sound and any smoke.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working/unknown mechanical condition (worst-case used scooter).

risks.risk: Brake performance may be weak or unsafe (pads/shoes worn, air in lines, cable issues).
risks.proof: Video clip: front and rear brake test from a standstill (show lever feel and stopping without pulling).
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes condition unknown/possibly needing service.

risks.risk: Tyres may be worn or have hidden punctures/sidewall cracks affecting safety and replacement cost.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tyres: tread depth, sidewalls, and any puncture marks; include a straight-on shot of each wheel.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tyres may need replacement soon.

risks.risk: Electricals may be faulty (indicators, horn, headlight beam, battery/charging).
risks.proof: Video clip: turn signals left/right, horn, high/low beam, brake light, and indicator dashboard lights.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming electricals may require troubleshooting/repair.

risks.risk: Chassis/frame may have accident damage or bends not obvious in the single wide shot.
risks.proof: Multiple angles: front fork alignment, both sides of frame, under-seat area, and wheel straightness check (straight-edge or alignment view).
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible structural/accident risk until alignment is confirmed.

risks.risk: Documents/registration may not match the bike (plate unreadable; ownership status unclear).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the full registration/plate details and any ownership document (name/number) matching the bike.
risks.if_unproven: Price as documentation not fully verifiable.

risks.risk: Age claim may be inaccurate; scooter shows used scuffing/dirt and age cannot be verified from photos.
risks.proof: Receipt/invoice date or service booklet; also odometer reading photo (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as older/used rather than near-new.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the make/model badge and any VIN/engine number (if present).
Send a cold-start video showing it starts, idles smoothly, and accelerates briefly.
Send a brake test video (front and rear) showing stopping power and no pulling.
Send close-up photos of tyres (tread + sidewalls) for both wheels.
Send a lights/electricals video: headlight (high/low), indicators, horn, brake light.
Send clear photos of registration/ownership documents with readable plate details.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a used motorbike/scooter, but key details (engine size, brand/model, mileage, running condition, tyres/brakes/electricals, and documents) are not verifiable from the report. I will price it at the worst-case used/needs-check level while requesting the missing proof to raise confidence.
